run_simulation_scenario: run a general store simulation scenario with a config, model, and embedder
create_simulation_config: create a simulation config with a premise, instances, and optional extra prefabs
get_prefabs: get the default prefab palette including entity and game master prefabs
review_run_scenario: review the run_scenario function to understand checkpoint capture and visualization output
refactor_create_simulation_config: refactor create_simulation_config to support additional prefab types or custom max steps
